neta-01-c2.text: L. Xu, S. Ha, I. Rhee, V. Goel, L. Eggert (2023). CUBIC for Fast and Long-Distance Networks (RFC 9438). IETF RFC Editor.
neta-01-c2.quote: For RTT-fairness, CUBIC is designed to achieve linear bandwidth sharing among flows with different RTTs.
neta-01-c2.claim: Growth depends on the time since the last loss, not on RTT, which makes CUBIC RTT-fair

neta-03-c2.text: RIPE NCC (2008). YouTube Hijacking: A RIPE NCC RIS case study.
neta-03-c2.quote: On Sunday, 24 February 2008, Pakistan Telecom (AS17557) started an unauthorised announcement of the prefix 208.65.153.0/24.
neta-03-c2.claim: Pakistan Telecom, ordered to block YouTube domestically, originated a more-specific BGP announcement for YouTube's prefix.

neta-04-c3.text: C. Hopps (2000). Analysis of an Equal-Cost Multi-Path Algorithm (RFC 2992). RFC Editor.
neta-04-c3.quote: Equal-cost multi-path (ECMP) is a routing technique for routing packets along multiple paths of equal cost.
neta-04-c3.claim: Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP, RFC 2992) lets a router send packets across multiple equally-good next hops.

neta-06-c2.text: Nick McKeown, Tom Anderson, Hari Balakrishnan, Guru Parulkar, Larry Peterson, Jennifer Rexford, Scott Shenker, Jonathan Turner (2008). OpenFlow: Enabling Innovation in Campus Networks. ACM SIGCOMM Computer Communication Review 38(2).
neta-06-c2.quote: This whitepaper proposes OpenFlow: a way for researchers to run experimental protocols in the networks they use every day.
neta-06-c2.claim: OpenFlow (2008, Stanford) was the first widely-deployed southbound SDN protocol.

neta-06-c3.text: Pat Bosshart, Dan Daly, Martin Izzard, Nick McKeown, Jennifer Rexford, Cole Schlesinger, Dan Talayco, Amin Vahdat, George Varghese, David Walker (2014). Programming Protocol-Independent Packet Processors. arXiv.
neta-06-c3.quote: P4 is a high-level language for programming protocol-independent packet processors.
neta-06-c3.claim: P4 (Programming Protocol-Independent Packet Processors, 2014) takes the next step: don't just configure the pipeline, program it.

neta-07-c2.text: Mohammad Alizadeh, Albert Greenberg, Dave Maltz, Jitu Padhye, Parveen Patel, Balaji Prabhakar, Sudipta Sengupta, Murari Sridharan (2010). Data Center TCP (DCTCP). Microsoft Research / ACM SIGCOMM 2010.
neta-07-c2.quote: DCTCP leverages Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) in the network to provide multi-bit feedback to the end hosts.
neta-07-c2.claim: DCTCP (Data Center TCP, Microsoft Research 2010) goes further

neta-09-c1.text: E. Rescorla (2018). The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3 (RFC 8446). RFC Editor.
neta-09-c1.quote: This document specifies version 1.3 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol.
neta-09-c1.claim: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018) was a near-rewrite of TLS.
